text:
Title it something like Zucchini scale salmon 
Skinned side of the salmon)
Smear the fillet with dijon Honey mustard, put thinly sliced zucchini with peel... Will look like scales
Combine in a bowl
Fresh dill finely chopped,  5 cloves fresh garlic, olive oil black pepper and salt. Smear it over the zucchini "scales" 
Bake half hour 375 uncovered
